# Keep the Light 1.44.0

- **New: "This is animation"** (under Video). For anime and cartoons it makes files smaller while keeping clean lines. With x265 it uses the encoder's animation tune and lets more frames reuse the ones around them; in a test the file came out about a quarter smaller at the same quality setting. NVENC and QuickSync reuse more frames too, as far as your graphics card allows (the log says what was used). Save it in a profile (for example "Anime") to switch it on in one go.
- When TMDB or TVmaze fills in a title it lists as animation, Keep the Light offers to tick the box for you.
